questions.question: When blind Bartimaeus heard that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by, what did he do?

answers.text: He started crying out to Jesus
He sent someone to bring Jesus
He waited for the crowd to pass

questions.question: Many people told blind Bartimaeus to be silent, and he quieted down and waited. True or false?
When blind Bartimaeus kept shouting to Jesus for mercy, what did Jesus do?

answers.text: He stopped and had him called over
He kept walking and waved to him
He sent a disciple to bless him

questions.question: After Jesus told blind Bartimaeus his faith had healed him, Bartimaeus had to wait a while for his sight to come back. True or false?
